title: 36 Hours in Steamboat Springs, Colo.
abstract: Winter sports enthusiasts flock to this northwestern Colorado resort town in the Yampa Valley, a spot that is typically blessed with an abundant blanket of low-moisture snow.

title: 36 Hours in Nevis
abstract: With its unspoiled beaches and slo-mo vibe, Nevis is the less developed and serene Caribbean many visitors crave.

title: 36 Hours in Houston
abstract: If you have a taste for dynamism and beautiful complexities, Houston is your buffet – and eating is the town sport.

title: 36 Hours in Oslo
abstract: The Norwegian capital is refashioning itself into a major cultural destination, with new museums, daring architecture, intriguing restaurants and myriad ways to celebrate the outdoors – even in the heart of winter.
